subject: profiles columns, auth.users FK, RLS test helpers (as_user/as_anon), migrate-at-startup
body:
# Contract S02 -> S03: profiles table, auth.users FK, RLS test helpers

Please reply with a `decision` (accept or amend). I start coding against this now.

## 1. `public.profiles` (migration 0001, `apps/api/migrations/versions/0001_core_schema.py`)

| column | type | null | default | constraint |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| user_id | uuid | not null | — | PK, `references auth.users(id) on delete cascade` |
| display_name | text | null | — | `char_length(display_name) between 1 and 120` |
| exam_target | text | not null | `'step1'` | in (`step1`,`step2ck`,`step3`) |
| exam_date | date | null | — | — |
| daily_hours | numeric(4,1) | not null | 8 | between 0 and 24 |
| study_days | smallint[] | not null | `'{1,2,3,4,5,6}'` | every element in 1..7 (ISO weekday) |
| timezone | text | not null | `'Asia/Kolkata'` | `char_length <= 64` (IANA name validated in the API, not in SQL) |
| pathway_stage | text | null | — | `references pathway_stages(key) on delete set null` (16 keys from data/pathway/pathway_stages.json; table is empty until seed 05, so leave it null in your tests) |
| settings | jsonb | not null | `'{}'` | `jsonb_typeof(settings) = 'object'` |
| created_at | timestamptz | not null | now() | — |
| updated_at | timestamptz | not null | now() | maintained by trigger `naadi_touch_updated_at` on update |

Deliberately NOT columns: `email` (PII; read it from the verified JWT), `is_admin` (stays `ADMIN_EMAILS`-based in the API per your brief). No trigger on `auth.users` creates profiles: your `/api/me` creates the row, idempotently, e.g.
`insert into profiles (user_id) values ((select auth.uid())) on conflict (user_id) do nothing` run AS THE USER (RLS allows it), then `select`.

## 2. RLS on profiles (and on every user-owned table, same shape)

- `alter table ... enable row level security; ... force row level security;`
- Four policies, all `to authenticated`: `<t>_select_own` (using), `<t>_insert_own` (with check), `<t>_update_own` (using + with check), `<t>_delete_own` (using), each `(select auth.uid()) = user_id`.
- `anon`: no policies and `revoke all` on the table; `authenticated`: `select, insert, update, delete` granted; `service_role` keeps Supabase defaults (bypasses RLS: use only for shared-content writes, never on user paths).
- `auth.uid()` reads `request.jwt.claims ->> 'sub'` (Supabase built-in), so on a pooled connection run per transaction:
  `set local role authenticated; select set_config('request.jwt.claims', '{"sub":"<uuid>","role":"authenticated"}', true);`
  Both are transaction-local, so the pooled connection is clean after commit/rollback. Requires a transaction (psycopg `async with conn.transaction():`; our pool uses autocommit=True, so the explicit transaction is mandatory, or `set local` is a no-op with a warning).

## 3. Test helpers (S02 owns; `apps/api/tests/db/`)

Module `apps/api/tests/db/rls.py` (import as `from tests.db.rls import ...`), sync psycopg 3 plus async twins:

```python
def database_url() -> str                       # DATABASE_URL or pytest.fail (never skip)
def ensure_migrated(url: str) -> None           # alembic upgrade head (idempotent, advisory-locked)
def create_auth_user(conn, *, email: str | None = None) -> uuid.UUID   # inserts into auth.users as postgres; random uuid + email
@contextmanager
def as_user(conn, user_id: uuid.UUID) -> Iterator[psycopg.Connection]  # transaction + set local role authenticated + claims; rolls back on exit
@contextmanager
def as_anon(conn) -> Iterator[psycopg.Connection]                     # transaction + set local role anon; rolls back
@asynccontextmanager
async def as_user_async(aconn, user_id) / as_anon_async(aconn)        # same for psycopg.AsyncConnection
```

Pytest fixtures in `apps/api/tests/db/conftest.py` (available to tests under `tests/db/`; if you need them elsewhere, import the functions above): `migrated_url` (session: ensures head), `pg` (sync superuser connection, autocommit), `user_a`, `user_b` (fresh auth.users rows, deleted after the test, cascade removes their data).

All db tests are marked `pytest.mark.integration` + `pytest.mark.db` (so the CI `checks` job's `-m "not integration"` skips them and the `db` job runs them). Destructive tests (downgrade) refuse to run unless DATABASE_URL points at localhost.

## 4. Migrations at startup

`python -m naadi_api.migrate` (alembic upgrade head under `pg_advisory_lock`) runs before uvicorn in the Space CMD, and I will make the Playwright webServer run it before uvicorn in CI e2e, so your e2e has `profiles` available. If you also edit `apps/web/playwright.config.ts`, tell me and I will coordinate via a claim.
